name: splitr
comment:overrides: Security patches for transitive deps (SCA report). brace-expansion 2.x keeps the 1.x expand() API so it is safe to unify. shell-quote/esbuild are single-major upgrades. Omitted deliberately: minimatch and fast-xml-parser (major bumps break glob@7 and the RN Android CLI), and js-yaml (majors 3 and 4 have incompatible APIs, so transitive copies can't be unified without breaking consumers).
